description:
Thirty years with the fire service, and the part people never expect is how much of it is not the fire at all. It's the morning after. It's standing in a kitchen that looks completely normal — dishes in the rack, mail on the counter — and following a black line up the wall to a spot the size of a dinner plate.

Almost none of the fires I want to talk about announced themselves. There's no bang and no flash. There's a connection somewhere that's been running a little warmer than it should for a year, and one night it gets warm enough.

What's changed in thirty years isn't the wiring. It's what we plug into it. The average house now carries four times the electrical load it did when I started, and a lot of it is charging while you sleep.

New videos every week for homeowners who'd rather check something tonight than find out the hard way. Nothing here is a scare — most of it takes ten minutes and costs nothing.

I'm Roy Callahan. Go check the rug.

#HomeSafety #FireSafety #HomeHazards
